app.name: Atlas
app.update: Atlas {latest} is available (you run {current}). Upgrade to the latest version.

forcedPassword.title: Choose a new password
forcedPassword.intro: {name}, an administrator requires you to change your password before you continue.

login.title: Sign in to Atlas
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.
login.codeHint: From your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.codeNeeded: This account uses two-factor authentication. Enter your code to continue.

auth.quote: A clearer tomorrow builds from a more focused today.

register.title: Create your account
register.open: Anyone with a {domain} address can register.
register.invite: You need an invite code to register.

home.title: Projects
home.empty: Create a project to start planning work.
home.intro: All your projects in one place. Open a board, a list or a hierarchy.

project.heroText: Overview, board, list, backlog, hierarchy, timeline, issues and README of this project.

board.conflict: Someone else changed this card. The board was reloaded.
board.help: Drag a card by its handle, or focus it and use Alt + arrow keys to move it.
board.createBlocked: New items cannot be created in this status. Move them here instead.
board.templateWarning: Part of the template no longer fits: {message}

cross.title: All projects
cross.readOnly: Overview only: columns group statuses by category. Open a project to move cards.
cross.intro: Every project's cards by status category. Read-only: open a project to move cards.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Personal access tokens let agents and scripts use Atlas over REST and MCP. A token can read, or read and write, and can be limited to projects.
tokens.emptyText: Create a token to connect Claude, Codex or a script.
tokens.secretOnce: Copy this token now. It is shown only once.
tokens.name: Name

item.title: Title
item.conflict: Someone else changed this item. Your edits were not saved.
item.attachmentAdd: Add an image (PNG, JPEG or WebP; or paste a screenshot)
item.descriptionHint: Describe the work. Markdown is supported.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.name: Name
milestones.deleteBlocked: Move or clear its items first.
milestones.adminOnly: Only project admins can change milestones.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.blocker_done: {other} is done, so {key} is no longer blocked
inbox.intro: Updates from the items you follow and the work assigned to you.

workflow.title: Statuses
workflow.intro: The columns of your board. Order them, set work-in-progress limits and choose the category that decides what counts as done.
workflow.grip: Reorder {name}: drag, or use the arrow keys
workflow.previewText: How your statuses run across the board.
workflow.requiresOf: Statuses an item must have been in before {name}
workflow.requiresHint: An item can only enter this status after it has been in the selected statuses.
workflow.merge: Merge statuses of one category into one board column
workflow.mergeHint: Off shows one column per status. On shows To do, In progress and Completed as three columns; each card shows its own status.
workflow.timeTrackingHint: Lets members with the time.log right book time on items. Existing bookings are kept when you turn it off.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your profile, security, API tokens and preferences.
settings.name: Name
settings.emailHint: The email address cannot be changed here.
settings.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings.cardFieldsHint: Which fields cards show on the board. Kept in this browser.
settings.notificationsHint: Choose which notifications reach your inbox.
settings.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Others see a small re-encoded copy; the original is never shown.
settings.emailChangeHint: Needs your password. There is no mail server to confirm the new address, so check it carefully.
settings.twoFactorIntro: Ask for a code from an authenticator app (TOTP) as well as your password when you sign in.
settings.enrolHint: Add this key to your authenticator app (enter it manually, or open the link on a device that has the app), then type the 6-digit code it shows.
settings.recoveryOnce: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your device. They are shown only now.
settings.disableHint: Needs your password and a current code, or a recovery code.
settings.deleteHint: Closes your account for good: sessions, tokens and memberships go, your name shows as Deleted user on what you created. This cannot be undone. You cannot do this while you are the only admin of the instance or of a project.
settings.emailNotificationsHint: Works once an administrator has set up email.

psettings.keyHint: The key is fixed after creation.
psettings.tokensIntro: Tokens limited to this project, for an agent or CI. A token can never do more than the admin who created it, and stops working when that admin leaves the project.
psettings.exportIntro: Download everything in this project, including archived items.
psettings.importIntro: Import a JSON export or a CSV file into this project. Run a dry run first: it checks every row with the real rules and writes nothing. One invalid row rejects the whole file.
psettings.archiveHint: Archiving hides the project from the lists and makes it read-only. Items are never deleted. You can restore it later through the API.
psettings.templatesIntro: Item templates pre-fill new items: type, priority, labels, description and a checklist. Pick one when creating an item, or by name through MCP.
psettings.placeholders: Placeholders in the prefix and description: {date} (today) and {user} (the person creating the item).
psettings.projectTemplateHint: Captures this project's statuses, WIP limits, transitions, labels, custom fields and item templates for new projects. No items, members or tokens. Global admins only.
psettings.subitemsHint: One per line as type: title. Indent two spaces to nest. They are created together with the item, in one go.

repo.title: Git repository
repo.intro: Link the repository that holds this project's code. Atlas only stores the address and shows the README; it never clones or logs in. Do not put credentials in the address.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Users, rights, the audit log and the effective instance settings.

system.logIntro: The latest {count} server log lines, kept in memory. Restarting the server clears them; the full log is on the server's standard output.
system.mcpIntro: Who is talking to /mcp. MCP over HTTP has no open connection, so a client counts as connected when it sent a request in the last 5 minutes. Counters reset on restart.
system.noClients: No client has used MCP since the server started.

admin.rightsIntro: What each project role may do; a change applies at once. Admin is fixed and every role can view. Add a custom role below, then assign it to members in project settings. A global admin may do everything.
admin.passwordForced: Signed out; the next sign-in must change the password.
admin.defaultRoleHint: Used when a member is added without choosing a role; the add-member form preselects it.
admin.rightsTokens: An API token can never do more than its owner, and is further limited by its scope (read, or read and write) and optionally to projects.

actions.workflow: Change statuses, transitions, custom fields and milestones

version.label: Version
version.devBuild: Not a release build (latest release: {latest}). Build with VERSION to track updates.
version.unknown: Latest version unknown (development build, check disabled or GitHub unreachable)

admin.instanceIntro: Effective settings. They come from the environment of the server and cannot be changed here.

settings.mcp_writes_per_hour: MCP writes per token per hour

admin.templatesIntro: Templates for new projects: workflow, labels, custom fields and item templates. Save one from a project's settings, or import JSON. Anyone who can create projects can start from them.
admin.totpReset: Two-factor authentication reset for that user.
admin.policyIntro: Who may create an account, how long passwords must be and how long a sign-in lasts. These settings are stored in the database.
admin.invitesIntro: Create an invite and send the link yourself: Atlas does not send email. An invite works once and expires.
admin.inviteOnce: Copy this link now. It is shown only once.
admin.instanceItemTemplatesIntro: Available in every project; a project template with the same name wins there.
admin.mailIntro: Let Atlas send email: invitations and, per user, notifications. Without these settings Atlas sends no email.

mailSource.environment: Using the ATLAS_SMTP_* environment settings. Saving here overrides them.

admin.mailPasswordSet: A password is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.mailTestSent: Test email sent to your address.

issues.intro: Bugs of this project. Report one, filter and work them like any item.

readme.title: README
readme.empty: This repository has no README.md in its root.
readme.unlinked: No repository is linked. A project admin can link one in the project settings.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.empty: No milestones or items with a due date in this range.
timeline.truncated: More items than can be shown. Choose a shorter range.
timeline.chartHint: Bars run from creation to due date. Milestones are diamonds. Use the list for a text version.

context.title: Project context
context.intro: Short, curated knowledge about this project for people and AI agents. Git stays the source for code and docs; entries point to it.
context.emptyText: Add what a newcomer or an agent would otherwise have to dig through the code for: architecture, decisions, conventions, pitfalls.
context.noSources: No sources: treat this as an unchecked note.
context.verifyHint: Only after you checked the entry against its sources.
context.conflict: Someone else changed this entry (now version {version}).
context.previewIntro: This is what an agent receives from context_get (bootstrap).
context.previewSize: {bytes} bytes, about {tokens} tokens (at 4 bytes per token)
context.previewEmpty: Nothing is pinned yet, so an agent gets an empty bootstrap.

time.title: Time
time.off: Time tracking is off for this project.
time.turnOn: Admins can turn it on in the workflow settings.
